title: 基准推断的组合性问题：AI评估中的可投射性
summary: 本文提出AI基准评估中的非组合原则：相邻推断的支持不能自动组合成链式结论，除非端点、假设对齐且依赖和不确定性被传递。通过法律研究案例和模拟，展示聚合稳定性可能掩盖后续投射所需的区分，并提出可投射性审计以诊断基准到应用论证中的无根据连接。
summary_en: The paper identifies a non-composition principle in AI benchmark evaluation: support for adjacent projections does not warrant their composition unless endpoints and assumptions align and dependencies are carried through. It introduces a projectibility audit to diagnose unsupported joins in benchmark-to-use arguments.
